input: Lack of capability or robustness is a risk associated with An artificially intelligent robot is designed to assist customers in a retail setting by providing helpful and informative responses to their queries. The robot aims to enhance the shopping experience by offering personalized support and guidance to users. It is intended to engage with customers, understand their needs, and provide relevant information to facilitate a smoother and more efficient shopping process.
